name: Huscoke Holdings Limited
summary: Huscoke Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company that makes, trades and exports coke in China. Its three segments cover coke trading, coke production from refined coal, and coal-related ancillary work such as washing raw coal and selling the resulting electricity and heat. It also deals in tar, crude benzene and sulfur and works on clean-energy use of coke oven gas. Incorporated in 1991, it was formerly named Huscoke Resources Holdings Limited.
